data.narrative:
Teralta operates in Climate & Energy, a sector populated by 9 observable peers: 1 public company (LNZA) and 8 private entities including Redwood Materials, QuantumScape, KoBold Metals, Electric Hydrogen, and Enovix. The company has raised $15.8M to date; its current stage and valuation remain undisclosed.

The peer-median method is not applicable here. While 8 same-sector comparables exist, none satisfy stage-alignment or valuation-tier filters required for reliable triangulation—specifically, fewer than 3 datapoints emerged when screening for same-stage peers, adjacent-stage peers, or similar-tier valuations. An all-sector median approach would introduce unacceptable noise given the heterogeneity of Climate & Energy business models, capital intensity, and revenue maturity. This constraint reflects a genuine scarcity of narrowly comparable private financings at Teralta's undisclosed stage.

Without defensible comparable company data, traditional valuation frameworks cannot be reliably applied. Any valuation estimate would rest on venture-stage fundamentals absent from this dataset: revenue run-rate, customer concentration, technology IP strength, and founder track record. The $15.8M raised to date provides a floor for prior valuation but does not determine current fair value. Further analysis would require either (1) disclosure of Teralta's stage and metrics, (2) expansion of peer screening criteria with documented rationale, or (3) application of venture-stage scoring methodologies tied to capital efficiency and market opportunity.
